messages:
Rae: Quick kickoff  we need a tight experiment for the next PLG webinar. Focus: reduce time-to-first-call and measure token efficiency. Keep messaging lean.

Jon: Two variants I want to try: fast-start (one-click redeem in modal, immediate sample call) vs cost-save (lead with prompt templates & cost benchmarks).

Priya: Landing copy idea for fast-start H1: 'One click. One call. Start generating.' For cost-save H1: 'Ship features that cost less, perform more.'

Zoe: Modal flow details: show credit balance, redeem CTA, then show 3 starter prompts inline. Modal payload example: ```{
  "modal_id": "redeem-cta",
  "prompts": ["assistant-short","summarize","code-compact"]
}``` Keep modal logic minimal.

growth-bot: Created experiment EXP-4982 variants=fast-start,cost-save start=2026-04-05. Tracking events: webinar_reg, modal_redeem, first_api_call, prompt_use, converted_paid.

Rae: Routing rule: if firmographic.top_tier == true OR signal.company_mrr > 5000 => tag sales-high-touch and notify #sales-inbound. Otherwise keep low-touch path with 3-email drip.

Jon: Email snippets: fast-start subject: 'Redeem credits in-product  ship an LLM demo' cost-save subject: 'Starter prompts  cut token cost by 30%'. Preheaders under 80 chars. I'll draft.

Priya: For landing A/B we'll add UTM params: utm_campaign=plg-web-seed2026&utm_source=webinar&utm_variant={{variant}}. Also add a hidden field to capture cohort_id for analytics.

Zoe: Demo script: show hosted 95ms p50 for 64 tokens, dedicated 28ms on same prompt; then show batching effect with 8-concurrent requests. Slide note: call out cost-per-1k-tokens.

Rae: Metrics to monitor: reg->redeem conversion within 24h, redeem->first_api_call within 4h, 7-day active users, avg tokens per active user. Baseline numbers from analytics?

growth-bot: Reminder: ensure events are instrumented with property variant and experiment_id.

Jon: Power calc quick note: need ~350 registrants/arm to detect 6% lift with 80% power. If webinar list is smaller, extend the experiment window.

Priya: I'll own copy & landing by Tue 11am. Zoe will build modal prototypes and sample payloads. Rae will coordinate routing spec with CS.

Zoe: I'll post prototype link here once ready. Will include screenshots and the JSON snippet for frontend.

Rae: Ok team, standup tomorrow 9am PT to review copy + modal. Thanks! :rocket:
